fields.description: Issue features local political and civic reporting and commentary, including claims that John Rowland will not be appointed Miami chief of police and discussion of Safety Director Andrew J. Kavanaugh’s arrival; coverage of City Clerk Harold E. Ross’s reported office shortage and the alleged failure to notify the bonding company; an article warning about loan sharks and salary buyers; notes on telephone company rate disputes; and ongoing Miami Life promotional content such as the “Most Attractive Working Girl” beauty contest (winner Miss Louise Wolfe of Red Cross Drug Department Store) along with sports and leisure items (horse racing tips, boxing, and a record blue marlin catch).
